info.description: DATABASE_SCHEMA.md §2.5. Extended for the Tenant Onboarding / Auth milestone with phone, password_hash and store_roles — see src/api/auth/services/auth.ts. `pin_hash`/PIN-login (TEN-004) is documented but out of this milestone's scope.

phone.description: Global uniqueness (not just per-tenant, unlike DATABASE_SCHEMA.md §2.5's email constraint) is a deliberate addition: POST /api/auth/login resolves a user from phone alone, before any tenant is known.

pin_hash.description: DATABASE_SCHEMA.md §2.5 / PRD.md TEN-004 — short numeric PIN for shared-terminal cashier login (POST /api/auth/pin-login), argon2id-hashed like password_hash. No 'set PIN' admin surface exists yet, so this stays null until a follow-up milestone adds one.
